title: GTA 6 pre-orders top $1.4bn, Sensor Tower says
description: GTA 6 pre-orders have passed $1.4 billion, says Sensor Tower, with 87% choosing the Ultimate Edition. Here's what it means for Fortnite and Roblox.

body.text: GTA 6 pre-orders have crossed an estimated $1.4 billion, according to market intelligence firm Sensor Tower, as reported by GamesIndustry.biz. The same report says 87% of those orders are for the Ultimate Edition. It shows how much demand Rockstar's next game is already pulling in, and which rival games may feel it at launch.

Sensor Tower says daily pre-order revenue across PlayStation and Xbox ranged from $2.4 million to $3.8 million through most of August. Then came Netflix's Extended Look at the game on August 27, and orders rose sixfold.

Revenue hit $16.3 million the day after the Netflix special, per the report, and has kept climbing ahead of launch. That makes GTA 6 the most pre-ordered game on PlayStation and Xbox storefronts, according to Sensor Tower.
These are estimates from a third-party analytics firm, not figures confirmed by the publisher.

The 87% share for the Ultimate Edition suggests most early buyers want the top tier rather than a standard copy. The source article does not break down what the edition includes or what it costs, so we will not guess here. Check the official storefronts for current pricing.
Which games could lose players to GTA 6?
Sensor Tower also looked at audience overlap. It expects Fortnite, GTA Online and other AAA single-player titles to be hit hardest.
Among PlayStation users who own GTA 5, 42% also own Fortnite, compared with 22% of all players. Sensor Tower said Fortnite and Roblox appear the most exposed on audience overlap.

Roblox, though, is expected to hold up. The firm noted that Roblox beat the catalogue in player count change in the month after five recent releases: Monster Hunter Wilds, Oblivion Remastered, Resident Evil Requiem, Crimson Desert and First Light. Its audience looks less likely to be pulled away by acclaimed single-player launches, Sensor Tower suggested.

Pre-order revenue is still rising ahead of launch, so the $1.4 billion figure is likely to move. Watch for fresh Sensor Tower data, and for how live-service games like Fortnite and the shooters on Open World's list respond with content or events. For Indian players, the real test will be how engagement shifts once the game is actually in people's hands.

faqs.q: How much have GTA 6 pre-orders made?
faqs.a: According to GamesIndustry.biz, citing Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has generated an estimated $1.4 billion or more in pre-order revenue.

faqs.q: Which GTA 6 edition are most people pre-ordering?
faqs.a: Sensor Tower estimates that 87% of GTA 6 pre-orders are for the Ultimate Edition.

faqs.q: Which games could lose players to GTA 6?
faqs.a: Sensor Tower expects Fortnite, GTA Online and other AAA single-player games to be most affected, while it thinks Roblox is likely to hold its audience better.
